description: One user's installation of one extension. It holds their own copy of the built entry, the version they run, and what they allowed the extension to do. Another user's installation of the same extension is a separate record with separate files. Deleting this removes that user's copy, their grants, and their extension state, and leaves every doctype, token and client script the extension made.

fields.description: Set from the session. The server never reads this from a caller.
fields.label: User

fields.description: The namespaced identity a frame carries over the bridge, as "publisher/name".
fields.label: Extension

fields.description: Where the files came from, shown in the panel. Not part of the identity: one user holds one installation of a name, whatever the source. Empty for an extension installed from a directory.
fields.label: Source URL

fields.description: Off stops this user's frames. It stops nobody else's.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: A brief summary shown below the label in the Extensions panel.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: One SVG file in the install root, such as icon.svg. The editor draws it beside the extension.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: The extension's own README, as Markdown. Builder Hub sends it, or the installer reads it from the author's folder.
fields.label: Readme

fields.description: The release this user runs. Another user can run another one.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Of the installed files. It also keys the editor frame, so a rebuild remounts it.
fields.label: Checksum

fields.description: JSON list of capability keys the manifest asked for. A grant cannot reach outside this list.
fields.label: Requested Capabilities

fields.description: JSON list of capability keys this user granted. A key absent here is not granted.
fields.label: Granted Capabilities

fields.description: A Hub install starts as Installing while a background job downloads it, then becomes Ready or Failed. Every other install path is Ready at once.
fields.label: Install State

fields.description: Why the last Hub install did not finish. Shown in the panel with a Retry.
fields.label: Install Error

name: Builder User Extension
